% An amsart document beside the list of figures and list of tables of an
% earlier build with no .aux, which loaded babel and biblatex and had no
% figures or tables: the list of figures holds babel's \babel@toc line,
% the list of tables biblatex's \defcounter line, and each an
% \addtocontents write of \oldmark, which this document does not define.
% This document loads etoolbox, which defines \defcounter, and neither
% babel nor biblatex. amsart's \@starttoc reads every list. The stale
% files stay as they are.
\documentclass{amsart}
\usepackage{etoolbox}
\begin{document}
\listoffigures
\listoftables
\section{First}
Text of the first section.
\begin{figure}[h]
\centering A figure.
\caption{New figure}
\end{figure}
\begin{table}[h]
\centering A table.
\caption{New table}
\end{table}
\end{document}
